body:
The underlying issue here is that GDScript keeps its own cache that isn't necessarily aligned with the main resource cache. In this case, the script isn't registered so the resource loader thinks the script will be loaded and so invokes the GDScript loader. Once there, it performs its own lookup in its own cache, where, in contrast, it's found.

Certain workarounds could be attempted, but it may be a good time to try to avoid part of the responsibility overlap between the main resource cache and the GDScript one.
Can you test this with a more recent version, like [`4.5.beta5`](https://godotengine.org/article/dev-snapshot-godot-4-5-beta-5/)? There has been further improvements to this.
